description: SPICE combines mission geometry data with software interfaces for spacecraft ephemerides, instrument pointing and observation planning. Its kernels and toolkit support engineering tasks throughout planetary mission design and operations. The resource is documented by NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratory, Navigation and Ancillary Information Facility. Kernels describe specific spacecraft, bodies, instruments and time intervals. Supported periods and accuracy therefore depend on the selected mission kernels. The provider supplies a public web description. Licence and any software or data charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. Only the cited documentation was inspected. Code execution, numerical performance and underlying data were not tested. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. The cited documentation is available online; underlying files were not downloaded. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established.
